symptom: `describe Administration.Administrator` (no type) answered "no describable document named ... found in the project" although `describe module role Administration.Administrator` describes it; the same for a user role (`describe Administrator`) and a navigation profile (`describe Responsive`).
cause: resolveDescribeType resolved through the catalog's objects view and, on a miss, a live scan of top-level units plus domain-model entities and associations. Module roles, user roles and navigation profiles are members of the module-security, project-security and navigation documents, so neither path ever saw them.
insight: Resolve members in the live fallback, not the objects view: the catalog has no complete module-role table (role_mappings lists only roles a user role maps), so a view built on it would answer 'not found' for an unmapped role, which is worse than a miss that falls back. The help text had codified the gap as a rule ('forms that have no single qualified name (... navigation, module role)'), which is why it read as by design for months.
